evidence.claim: City 'Current development applications' list (Oct 2026) has no entry for 82 or 88 Arkell Road; only Arkell entries are 190-216 Arkell Rd (OZS18-008) and 220 Arkell Rd (OZS19-017), different lots.
Active Development Files archive lists only 190-216 and 220 Arkell Road for Arkell Road; nothing for 82/88.
Search '"88 Arkell Road" Guelph for sale OR sold OR development' returned only unrelated Arkell Rd condo/townhouse listings (167, 361, 60 Arkell); no listing/sale/application for 88.

summary: No application, assembly, listing or sale found for 88 (or neighbour 82) Arkell Road; heritage register PDF and MLS could not be read, so absence of evidence only. 18 units is a bylaw ceiling (setbacks, parking, servicing ignored).
